cases.name: Cloudflare BYOIP outage during configuration change
cases.context: A configuration change withdrew customer-owned IP prefixes and created divergent system states.
reported_facts: Cloudflare reports an impact duration of 6 hours 7 minutes
The postmortem identifies a schema/string issue and distinguishes configured from operational state
inferences_allowed: Configuration state needs validation, health mediation, staged exposure, and a rehearsed recovery path
cases.verified_outcomes: Only the remediation and impact reported by Cloudflare; no independent verification claimed.
tradeoffs_and_failures: Iterative rollout reduced initial blast radius but did not make recovery trivial
lessons: Test operational state, not configuration acceptance alone
cases.limitations: First-party retrospective; details are specific to Cloudflare architecture.

cases.name: Cloudflare dashboard and API outage
cases.context: A frontend loop amplified requests and overwhelmed API capacity.
reported_facts: Cloudflare reports that control/data separation limited customer traffic impact
The report identifies a frontend loop, thundering-herd behavior, absent staged rollout, and observability gaps
inferences_allowed: Observe retries separately from new demand
Control-plane failure can still block operation even when data processing continues
cases.verified_outcomes: Reported restoration and corrective work only; not independently audited here.
tradeoffs_and_failures: Capacity assumptions did not hold under amplified requests
lessons: Instrument demand source and retry behavior

cases.name: Cloudflare KV dependency blocked rollback access
cases.context: A deployment tool misconfiguration caused an outage while an access dependency complicated rollback.
constraints: Administrative access depended on an impaired service
reported_facts: Cloudflare reports that Access depended on KV during the incident
The report discusses break-glass access and testing rollback with known-good identifiers
inferences_allowed: Recovery paths should not share every dependency with the failed path
cases.verified_outcomes: Restoration and remediation as reported by Cloudflare.
tradeoffs_and_failures: Security/access control dependency conflicted with emergency recoverability
lessons: Test the rollback mechanism, permissions, and identifiers
cases.limitations: First-party report; does not justify weakening routine access controls.

cases.name: GitHub database migration under peak load
cases.context: A migration combined with peak traffic saturated database connections.
reported_facts: GitHub reports database connection saturation during a migration and peak load
The report says the event was detected in roughly three minutes
inferences_allowed: Migration safety must include representative concurrent load and connection budgets
cases.verified_outcomes: Availability impact and remediation as reported by GitHub.
tradeoffs_and_failures: Migration progress and production capacity competed for constrained resources
lessons: Model migration load as production load
Define abort and recovery signals before change
cases.limitations: Only facts stated in GitHub's public report may be used.

cases.name: Anthropic production model-quality incidents
cases.context: Three production quality issues exposed weaknesses in noisy evaluation and detection.
reported_facts: Anthropic describes three issues and changes to evaluations, production monitoring, and canarying
inferences_allowed: Aggregate or noisy evals can miss important regressions
AI rollout needs both preproduction and production evidence
cases.verified_outcomes: Corrective actions are employer-reported; no independent performance validation claimed.
lessons: Segment evaluations by risk and behavior

cases.name: Morgan Stanley advisor assistant adoption and evaluation
cases.context: AI retrieval, summarization, and translation were introduced into an advisor workflow with controls and evaluations.
reported_facts: The vendor story reports 98 percent advisor-team active use
The story describes an evaluation framework and controlled workflows
inferences_allowed: Workflow-specific evaluations and adoption evidence should be designed together
cases.verified_outcomes: All outcome figures remain attributed to the vendor/customer story and are not independently verified.
tradeoffs_and_failures: Broad aggregate adoption versus task-level value
lessons: Pair use metrics with task and guardrail evidence
cases.limitations: Curated success story; selection effects and counterfactual are not available.

cases.name: Tax AI agents built from production traces
cases.context: Tax-agent development used collaboration across forward deployment, research, and customer teams with production traces feeding evaluation.
reported_facts: OpenAI reports a pilot involving 7,000 returns and more than 30 firms
The article describes production traces feeding evaluations
inferences_allowed: Production evidence can reveal evaluation gaps and reusable patterns
cases.verified_outcomes: Pilot scale and results are company-reported; no independent audit claimed.
tradeoffs_and_failures: Learning from production while bounding regulated risk
lessons: Do not turn observed errors into universal tax claims
cases.limitations: Vendor-authored and domain details are necessarily incomplete.

cases.name: OpenAI in-house data agent
cases.context: An internal data agent uses reference SQL/results, continuous evaluation, and production canaries.
reported_facts: The article describes gold SQL/results, continuous evaluations, and production canaries
inferences_allowed: Data-agent quality requires outcome checks beyond syntactic query success
cases.verified_outcomes: Engineering approach is self-reported; no independent accuracy figure used.
tradeoffs_and_failures: Reference-set coverage versus changing production questions
lessons: Separate execution success from answer correctness
cases.limitations: Internal vendor case; tooling and data estate are not representative of every customer.

cases.name: AWS idempotent API design pattern
cases.context: Distributed API clients retry operations when responses are missing or delayed.
reported_facts: AWS describes client request identifiers and semantic-equivalence handling in its APIs
inferences_allowed: Retry safety is a business-semantic contract, not just a transport setting
cases.verified_outcomes: No quantitative outcome is claimed in the book.
tradeoffs_and_failures: Same parameters may represent a new user intent
lessons: Test late, duplicate, and conflicting requests
cases.limitations: Pattern report rather than a controlled study.

cases.name: Orchid Assist deployment dossier
cases.context: A fictional industrial field-service workflow used to exercise the full FDE lifecycle.
inferences_allowed: Only conclusions produced transparently from stated fictional assumptions
tradeoffs_and_failures: Every failure injection is pedagogical and must remain labeled fictional
lessons: A constructed case may demonstrate method but cannot prove external prevalence or outcome
cases.limitations: No real company, employee, system, endorsement, or outcome is represented.
